name: SKG Hunt
summary:
An original video game by Break
“When they refuse to listen...the streets choose their own flavour.”
Fly as a bat in the skies of Thessaloniki collect Ion Break chocolates and deliver them to their destination, avoiding the law in the process. A video-game, part of the advertising campaign by Ion Cocoa & Chocolate Manufacturers S.A. Developed by GET SOME SLEEP.
